sub.scene: A traveller with a suitcase walks through a bright airport hall toward a row of check-in desks.
A guest in a lobby stands at a reception desk with a suitcase while a smiling receptionist hands over a key card.
A traveller with a backpack studies a paper map on a busy street with a bus and a taxi nearby.
A small group follows a guide with a flag up a stone path toward an old temple on a sunny day.

name.vi: Sự cố khi đi du lịch

sub.scene: A tired traveller sits beside one suitcase at an empty airport gate while an agent at a desk looks at a screen.
A traveller at a counter hands over a passport and a few banknotes to an officer behind a glass window.

words.ex: We got to the airport three hours before our flight.
words.tip: Air + port: "cảng" của máy bay.

words.ex: Our flight to Seoul leaves at seven in the morning.
words.tip: Flight (chuyến bay) khác fly (động từ bay).

words.ex: I bought two plane tickets for the summer holiday.
words.tip: Vé máy bay, vé tàu, vé vào cửa đều là ticket.

words.ex: Don't forget your passport when you check in.
words.tip: Pass (đi qua) + port (cảng): giấy để qua cửa khẩu.

words.ex: My luggage was heavier than the airline allowed.
words.tip: Không đếm được: nói "two pieces of luggage".

words.ex: She packed a small suitcase for the weekend trip.
words.tip: Suit (bộ đồ) + case (hộp): vali đựng quần áo.

words.ex: Your flight leaves from gate twelve, so hurry up.
words.tip: Gate là cổng ra máy bay, có số riêng.

words.ex: The departure time was moved forward by an hour.
words.tip: Depart (khởi hành) + ure; ngược lại là arrival.

words.ex: After our arrival, we took a taxi to the hotel.
words.tip: Arrive (đến) thành danh từ arrival.

words.ex: There was a two-hour delay because of the storm.
words.tip: Delay: trễ giờ; đi với "because of" + lý do.

words.ex: Every passenger must show an ID at the gate.
words.tip: Passenger: người ngồi trên xe/tàu/máy bay, không lái.

words.ex: Please keep your boarding pass until you reach your seat.
words.tip: Board (lên tàu) + pass (thẻ): thẻ để lên máy bay.

words.ex: You can check in online twenty-four hours before departure.
words.tip: Check in: làm thủ tục; danh từ viết là check-in.

words.ex: I only took a carry-on bag, so I skipped the queue.
words.tip: Carry (xách) + on (lên máy bay): hành lý xách tay.

words.ex: I always ask for a window seat to see the clouds.
words.tip: Ghế cạnh cửa sổ; đối lập là aisle seat.
words.def: a seat next to the window in a plane or train

words.ex: He chose an aisle seat so he could stretch his legs.
words.tip: Aisle đọc là "ai-ơ", lối đi giữa các hàng ghế.

words.ex: The plane will take off in about ten minutes.
words.tip: Take off: cất cánh (cũng là cởi áo); ngược lại: land.

words.ex: We landed in Hanoi just before midnight.
words.tip: Land cũng là "đất": máy bay "chạm đất" là hạ cánh.

words.ex: There is a direct flight from Saigon to Singapore.
words.tip: Direct: thẳng, không dừng giữa đường.
words.def: a flight that does not stop on the way

words.ex: I missed my connecting flight after a late arrival.
words.tip: Connect = nối; chuyến bay nối tiếp chuyến trước.

words.ex: We had a five-hour layover in Doha.
words.tip: Lay over: nằm lại giữa đường, đợi chuyến nối.

words.ex: The security check took longer than I expected.
words.tip: Kiểm tra an ninh: bỏ laptop và chất lỏng ra khay.
words.def: the place where bags and people are checked before a flight

words.ex: Wait for me at the baggage claim near the exit.
words.tip: Claim = nhận về; nơi nhận lại hành lý ký gửi.

words.ex: Our flight leaves from terminal two, not terminal one.
words.tip: Terminal là nhà ga của sân bay, thường có số.

words.ex: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.
words.tip: Hotel đọc nhấn âm 2: /hoʊˈtel/ (ho-TEL).

words.ex: Our room has a balcony with a view of the sea.
words.tip: Room còn nghĩa là "chỗ trống": no room = hết chỗ.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two nights in July.
words.tip: Reserve (giữ chỗ) + ation: đặt trước phòng, bàn.

words.ex: Please leave your key at reception when you go out.
words.tip: Reception: quầy lễ tân; receptionist: người trực quầy.

words.ex: Check-in starts at two o'clock in the afternoon.
words.tip: Giờ nhận phòng; ngược lại là check-out.

words.ex: Checkout is at eleven, but you can leave your bags.
words.tip: Check out: trả phòng, rời khách sạn.

words.ex: We need to check out before eleven tomorrow morning.
words.tip: Check out (động từ viết rời) = trả phòng.

words.ex: A single room is cheaper, but the bed is small.
words.tip: Single = một người; phòng cho một người ở.

words.ex: We booked a double room with a sea view.
words.tip: Double = đôi; giường đôi cho hai người.

words.ex: Friends often choose a twin room to save money.
words.tip: Twin = sinh đôi: hai giường đơn giống nhau.

words.ex: They upgraded us to a suite on our anniversary.
words.tip: Suite đọc là "swiit", phòng lớn nhiều khu vực.

words.ex: The price includes accommodation and breakfast every day.
words.tip: Không đếm được; có hai "c" và hai "m".

words.ex: The hotel has excellent facilities, including a gym.
words.tip: Facilities: tiện nghi, thường dùng số nhiều.
words.def: rooms or equipment provided for a particular purpose

words.ex: Breakfast is included in the price of the room.
words.tip: Included đứng sau danh từ: "tax included" = đã gồm thuế.
words.def: counted as part of the price or total

words.ex: I booked the hotel online two months ago.
words.tip: Book còn là "sách", nhưng ở đây là đặt trước.

words.ex: The sign said there were no vacancies in town.
words.tip: Vacant = trống; hết phòng ghi "No vacancies".

words.ex: Sorry, the hotel is fully booked this weekend.
words.tip: Fully (hoàn toàn) + booked: đã kín chỗ.

words.ex: We ordered breakfast through room service on Sunday.
words.tip: Gọi món mang tận phòng, thường tính phí thêm.

words.ex: Call the front desk if the air conditioner breaks.
words.tip: Cách nói Mỹ của "reception" (quầy lễ tân).

words.ex: My key card stopped working, so I went downstairs.
words.tip: Thẻ từ mở cửa phòng, thay chìa khóa.

words.ex: Could I have a wake-up call at six tomorrow?
words.tip: Cuộc gọi đánh thức của khách sạn.

words.ex: The room has a lovely view of the mountains.
words.tip: View = cảnh nhìn từ phòng; "sea view" là hướng biển.

words.ex: We stayed at a friend's house for three nights.
words.tip: Stay at + nơi ở; stay for + thời gian.

words.ex: Let's take a taxi, because the bus is too slow.
words.tip: Taxi giống tiếng Việt, chỉ đọc /ˈtæksi/.

words.ex: The bus to the old town runs every fifteen minutes.
words.tip: On the bus (trên xe buýt), by bus (đi bằng xe buýt).

words.ex: The train to the capital takes about four hours.
words.tip: Train còn nghĩa là "huấn luyện" (động từ).

words.ex: Meet me outside the central station at noon.
words.tip: Station: ga/trạm; train station = ga tàu.

words.ex: I checked the map to find the nearest metro stop.
words.tip: Map: bản đồ; "on the map" = trên bản đồ.

words.ex: The train to Hue leaves from platform four.
words.tip: Platform là sân ga, có số riêng.

words.ex: The subway is the fastest way to cross the city.
words.tip: Subway Mỹ = tube/underground Anh = tàu điện ngầm.

words.ex: The bus fare went up by ten percent last year.
words.tip: Fare: tiền vé đi xe, khác fair (công bằng).

words.ex: We got on the train just before the doors closed.
words.tip: Get on: lên xe buýt/tàu/máy bay; ngược lại get off.
words.def: to climb onto a bus, train or plane

words.ex: Please tell me when to get off the bus.
col: get off at the next stop
words.tip: Get off: xuống xe; không dùng với taxi hay ô tô nhỏ.
words.def: to leave a bus, train or plane

words.ex: You have to change trains at the next station.
words.tip: Đổi tàu giữa đường; "change" không có "a".
words.def: to leave one train and take another to continue the journey

words.ex: We decided to rent a car and explore the coast.
col: rent a car for a week
words.tip: Rent: thuê ngắn hạn, trả tiền theo ngày.
words.def: to pay to use a car for a short time

words.ex: The car rental office is just outside the terminal.
words.tip: Car rental là dịch vụ cho thuê ô tô.

words.ex: You need a driving licence to rent a car here.
words.tip: Anh: licence; Mỹ: driver's license.

words.ex: We stopped to ask for directions to the station.
words.tip: Directions luôn dùng số nhiều khi hỏi đường.
words.def: to ask someone how to get to a place

words.ex: Turn left at the traffic lights and walk straight.
words.tip: Left = trái, right = phải; ghi nhớ tay trái viết "L".
words.def: to change direction towards the left side

words.ex: Go straight for two blocks, then you'll see the bank.
words.tip: Straight = thẳng, "straight ahead" = thẳng phía trước.
words.def: to continue forward without turning

words.ex: The old town is small, so we explored it on foot.
words.tip: Đi bộ: dùng "on foot", không dùng "by foot".
words.def: by walking and not by vehicle

words.ex: Public transport is cheap and fast in this city.
words.tip: Phương tiện công cộng; không đếm được.

words.ex: We took the ferry across the river to the island.
words.tip: Ferry là phà, chở người và xe qua sông hoặc biển.

words.ex: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
col: be stuck in a traffic jam
words.tip: Jam = kẹt cứng: tắc đường.

words.ex: A round trip ticket is cheaper than two single ones.
words.tip: Round (vòng) + trip: đi và về; Anh gọi là "return".
words.def: a journey to a place and back again

words.ex: Thousands of tourists visit this beach every summer.
words.tip: Tourist: khách du lịch; tour là chuyến đi.

words.ex: The museum is free on the first Sunday of the month.
words.tip: Museum: nhấn âm 2 /mjuˈziːəm/.

words.ex: We joined a walking tour of the old town.
words.tip: Tour: chuyến đi tham quan theo lịch trình.

words.ex: Our guide told us stories about the old temple.
words.tip: Guide vừa là hướng dẫn viên vừa là sách hướng dẫn.

words.ex: I bought a small souvenir for each of my friends.
words.tip: Souvenir đọc /ˌsuːvəˈnɪə/: quà lưu niệm.

words.ex: Don't forget your camera, the view is amazing.
words.tip: Camera: máy ảnh; đọc /ˈkæmərə/, ba âm tiết.

words.ex: We spent the whole afternoon on the beach.
words.tip: Beach đọc /biːtʃ/, âm ee kéo dài (bãi biển).

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Hue on our first day.
words.tip: Sight (cảnh) + seeing (ngắm): đi tham quan.

words.ex: The tower is the most famous landmark in the city.
words.tip: Land (đất) + mark (dấu): địa danh nổi tiếng.

words.ex: The old bridge is the main tourist attraction here.
words.tip: Attract (thu hút) + ion: điểm hấp dẫn khách.

words.ex: Admission to the castle costs ten euros per adult.
words.tip: Admission: tiền vào cửa; "admission fee" phổ biến.

words.ex: The entrance fee is cheaper for children and students.
words.tip: Entrance: lối vào; fee: lệ phí.
words.def: money you pay to enter a place

words.ex: Check the opening hours before you walk all the way there.
words.tip: Opening hours: giờ mở cửa; luôn số nhiều.

words.ex: There was a long queue outside the museum entrance.
words.tip: Queue đọc /kjuː/: hàng người chờ (Mỹ: line).

words.ex: We booked a tour of the islands for Saturday.
words.tip: Book + tour: đặt trước chuyến tham quan.
words.def: to arrange a guided trip in advance

words.ex: You can buy a ticket at the machine by the door.
words.tip: Buy (mua) khác by (bằng): buy a ticket.
words.def: to pay for a ticket to travel or enter somewhere

words.ex: Visitors may take photos, but flashes are not allowed.
words.tip: Take photos hay dùng hơn "make photos".
words.def: to make pictures with a camera or phone

words.ex: An audio guide explains each room in six languages.
words.tip: Hướng dẫn bằng tai nghe, không cần người dẫn.
words.def: a recorded talk that explains a place as you walk

words.ex: The old market was crowded with tourists at noon.
words.tip: Crowd (đám đông) + ed: đông đúc.
words.def: full of many people

words.ex: We climbed to the view point to watch the sunset.
words.tip: Điểm ngắm cảnh trên cao, thường có lan can.
words.def: a place from which you can see a wide view

words.ex: The scenery along the coast road is breathtaking.
words.tip: Scenery không đếm được, chỉ phong cảnh.

words.ex: We tried local food at every small restaurant we found.
words.tip: Local: địa phương; tiếp xúc văn hóa qua ăn.
words.def: food that is typical of a particular place

words.ex: We missed the last train and walked home.
words.tip: Miss: lỡ, bỏ lỡ; cũng là "nhớ".

words.ex: I filled in a form for my lost luggage.
words.tip: Lost + luggage: hành lý bị thất lạc.
words.def: bags that cannot be found after a journey

words.ex: I lost my wallet somewhere near the market.
words.tip: Lose (mất) /luːz/, loose /luːs/ là "lỏng".

words.ex: My phone was stolen on the crowded bus.
words.tip: Stolen là quá khứ phân từ của steal (ăn cắp).
words.def: taken away by someone without permission

words.ex: We got lost in the narrow streets of the old town.
words.tip: Get lost: lạc đường; Rude "Get lost!" = cút đi.
words.def: to lose your way and not know where you are

words.ex: Sorry, I'm late, my train was delayed.
words.tip: Late for + sự kiện: late for the flight.
words.def: to arrive or happen after the expected time

words.ex: They cancelled our flight because of the heavy fog.
words.tip: Cancel (hủy) Anh viết hai "l": cancelled.

words.ex: Our flight was cancelled, so we stayed one more night.
words.tip: Cancelled flight khác "delayed flight" (trễ).
words.def: stopped from happening as planned

words.ex: I asked the airline for a full refund.
words.tip: Re (lại) + fund (tiền): hoàn lại tiền.

words.ex: The airline offered us compensation for the long delay.
words.tip: Compensate (bù đắp) + ion: tiền bồi thường.

words.ex: I made a complaint about the dirty room.
words.tip: Complain (phàn nàn) -> complaint: lời khiếu nại.

words.ex: Call this number in case of an emergency.
words.tip: Emergency: khẩn cấp; số điện thoại khẩn cấp nữa.

words.ex: He was taken to the nearest hospital by ambulance.
words.tip: Hospital: bệnh viện; "in hospital" Anh, "in the hospital" Mỹ.

words.ex: Half of us got food poisoning after the street dinner.
words.tip: Poison (độc) -> poisoning: ngộ độc thực phẩm.
words.def: an illness caused by eating bad food

words.ex: I got terrible sunburn after one afternoon at the beach.
words.tip: Sun (nắng) + burn (cháy): cháy nắng.
words.def: red painful skin caused by too much sun

words.ex: I feel travel sick on winding mountain roads.
words.tip: Say xe, say tàu; Mỹ: motion sickness.
words.def: feeling ill because of the movement of a vehicle

words.ex: Is there a pharmacy near the hotel?
words.tip: Pharmacy: hiệu thuốc; nhấn âm đầu /ˈfɑːməsi/.

words.ex: We ran out of petrol on a quiet country road.
words.tip: Run out of + danh từ: hết, cạn mất.

words.ex: Our bus broke down halfway to the airport.
words.tip: Break down: hỏng máy giữa đường.
words.def: to stop working, especially a vehicle

words.ex: You can make a claim if the airline loses your bag.
words.tip: Claim: đòi quyền lợi, bồi thường.
words.def: to ask a company to pay for a loss

words.ex: The airline rebooked us on a flight the next day.
words.tip: Re (lại) + book: đặt lại chuyến.
words.def: to book a new ticket or room for a different time

words.ex: The flight was overbooked, so some passengers waited.
words.tip: Over (quá) + booked: bán vé nhiều hơn ghế.
words.def: sold more tickets or rooms than are available

words.ex: Check the lost property office at the station.
words.tip: Lost property: nơi giữ đồ thất lạc; Mỹ: lost and found.

words.ex: Many small shops in the market only take cash.
words.tip: Cash: tiền mặt; "in cash" = bằng tiền mặt.

words.ex: Can I pay by credit card at this shop?
words.tip: Credit (tín dụng) + card: thẻ tín dụng.
words.def: a plastic card used to pay now and pay later

words.ex: The local currency is the dong, not the dollar.
words.tip: Currency: loại tiền của một nước.

words.ex: I need to exchange some dollars into euros.
words.tip: Exchange: đổi tiền; "exchange rate" là tỷ giá.

words.ex: The exchange rate is better at the bank than here.
words.tip: Exchange rate: tỷ giá, thay đổi mỗi ngày.

words.ex: There is an ATM next to the train station.
words.tip: ATM đọc từng chữ: ay-ti-em; rút tiền tự động.
words.def: a machine in the street that gives you cash

words.ex: We left a ten percent tip for the waiter.
words.tip: Tip: tiền boa; cũng là "mẹo nhỏ".

words.ex: Please keep the receipt in case you need a refund.
words.tip: Receipt đọc /rɪˈsiːt/, chữ "p" câm.

words.ex: Could we have the bill, please?
words.tip: Bill Anh = hóa đơn nhà hàng; Mỹ hay dùng "check".

words.ex: Do I need a visa to visit your country?
words.tip: Visa: thị thực, cấp cho từng người, từng thời hạn.

words.ex: We went through customs without any problem.
words.tip: Customs (số nhiều) = hải quan; custom = phong tục.

words.ex: The immigration officer asked about our travel plans.
words.tip: Immigration: nhập cảnh; quầy kiểm soát hộ chiếu.

words.ex: Do you have anything to declare, sir?
words.tip: Declare: khai báo hàng hóa ở hải quan.

words.ex: Travel insurance covers medical costs while you are abroad.
words.tip: Insurance: bảo hiểm; "insure" là động từ.

words.ex: The car rental price includes full insurance.
words.tip: Insurance đọc /ɪnˈʃɔːrəns/: bảo hiểm.

words.ex: The price of the room includes a ten percent tax.
words.tip: Tax là thuế; "tax-free" = miễn thuế.

words.ex: We bought perfume at a duty-free shop in the airport.
words.tip: Duty (thuế) + free (miễn): hàng miễn thuế.
words.def: sold without the usual tax

words.ex: The queue at passport control moved quite fast.
words.tip: Nơi kiểm tra hộ chiếu khi nhập cảnh.

words.ex: Keep every travel document in one safe place.
words.tip: Document: giấy tờ, đừng nhầm với "documentary".
words.def: an official paper needed to enter a country

words.ex: My passport expires in two months, so I must renew it.
words.tip: Expire: hết hạn; expiry date = ngày hết hạn.

words.ex: Your passport must be valid for at least six months.
words.tip: Valid: còn hiệu lực; ngược lại là expired.

words.ex: Please fill in this form before you enter the country.
words.tip: Fill in (Anh) = fill out (Mỹ): điền mẫu.
words.def: to write information in a form

phrases.en: Where is the check-in desk for this flight?
phrases.vi: Quầy làm thủ tục của chuyến bay này ở đâu?

phrases.en: Could I have a window seat, please?
phrases.vi: Cho tôi ghế cạnh cửa sổ được không?

phrases.en: What time does boarding start?
phrases.vi: Mấy giờ bắt đầu lên máy bay?

phrases.en: Is this flight delayed or on time?
phrases.vi: Chuyến bay này bị trễ hay đúng giờ?

phrases.en: I'd like to check in two bags, please.
phrases.vi: Tôi muốn ký gửi hai túi hành lý.

phrases.en: I have a reservation under the name Nguyen.
phrases.vi: Tôi có đặt phòng dưới tên Nguyễn.

phrases.en: What time is check-out tomorrow?
phrases.vi: Mai mấy giờ phải trả phòng?

phrases.en: Is breakfast included in the price?
phrases.vi: Giá phòng đã gồm bữa sáng chưa?

phrases.en: Could you send someone to fix the air conditioner?
phrases.vi: Bạn cử người sửa máy lạnh giúp tôi được không?

phrases.en: Do you have any rooms available tonight?
phrases.vi: Tối nay còn phòng trống không?

phrases.en: How do I get to the central station from here?
phrases.vi: Từ đây đi ra ga trung tâm thế nào?

phrases.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the old town?
phrases.vi: Xin lỗi, xe buýt này có đi khu phố cổ không?

phrases.en: Could you take me to this address, please?
phrases.vi: Bạn chở tôi đến địa chỉ này được không?

phrases.en: How much is a one-way ticket to the airport?
phrases.vi: Vé một chiều ra sân bay bao nhiêu?

phrases.en: Which platform does the train to Hue leave from?
phrases.vi: Tàu đi Huế khởi hành từ sân ga nào?

phrases.en: What time does the museum open?
phrases.vi: Bảo tàng mở cửa lúc mấy giờ?

phrases.en: Are there any guided tours in English?
phrases.vi: Có tour có hướng dẫn bằng tiếng Anh không?

phrases.en: Could you take a photo of us, please?
phrases.vi: Bạn chụp giúp chúng tôi một tấm ảnh được không?

phrases.en: Is there a student discount on tickets?
phrases.vi: Vé có giảm giá cho sinh viên không?

phrases.en: What would you recommend we see in one day?
phrases.vi: Bạn khuyên chúng tôi nên xem gì trong một ngày?

phrases.en: I think I've lost my passport.
phrases.vi: Tôi nghĩ mình đã làm mất hộ chiếu.

phrases.en: My luggage hasn't arrived yet.
phrases.vi: Hành lý của tôi vẫn chưa tới.

phrases.en: Could you help me? I feel quite sick.
phrases.vi: Bạn giúp tôi được không? Tôi thấy khá mệt.

phrases.en: I'd like to ask for a refund, please.
phrases.vi: Tôi muốn xin hoàn lại tiền.

phrases.en: We missed our connection. What are our options?
phrases.vi: Chúng tôi lỡ chuyến nối. Có phương án nào không?

phrases.en: Where can I exchange some money?
phrases.vi: Tôi đổi tiền ở đâu được?

phrases.en: Do you take credit cards?
phrases.vi: Bên bạn có nhận thẻ tín dụng không?

phrases.en: I'm here on holiday for two weeks.
phrases.vi: Tôi sang đây nghỉ lễ hai tuần.

phrases.en: I have nothing to declare.
phrases.vi: Tôi không có gì phải khai báo.

phrases.en: Does my insurance cover medical costs abroad?
phrases.vi: Bảo hiểm của tôi có chi trả viện phí ở nước ngoài không?

lines: A
Hello, I'd like to check in for the flight to Bangkok.
Xin chào, tôi muốn làm thủ tục cho chuyến bay đi Bangkok.
B
Certainly. May I see your passport? Any bags to check in?
Vâng. Cho tôi xem hộ chiếu nhé? Bạn có ký gửi hành lý không?
A
One suitcase. Could I have a window seat, please?
Một vali. Cho tôi ghế cạnh cửa sổ được không?
B
Of course. Here is your boarding pass. Boarding starts at gate twelve at six.
Được ạ. Đây là thẻ lên máy bay. Giờ lên máy bay ở cổng 12 lúc sáu giờ.
A
Excuse me, is the flight to Osaka delayed?
Xin lỗi, chuyến bay đi Osaka có bị trễ không?
B
Yes, there is a one-hour delay because of the weather.
Có, trễ một tiếng vì thời tiết.
A
Thanks. I'll wait near the gate, then.
Cảm ơn. Vậy tôi sẽ chờ gần cổng.
A
Good evening. I have a reservation for two nights under Tran.
Chào buổi tối. Tôi có đặt phòng hai đêm dưới tên Trần.
B
Yes, a double room with a sea view. Here is your key card.
Vâng, phòng đôi hướng biển. Đây là thẻ từ của bạn.
A
Is breakfast included in the price?
Giá phòng đã gồm bữa sáng chưa?
B
Yes, it's served from seven to ten. Checkout is at eleven.
Có, phục vụ từ bảy đến mười giờ. Trả phòng lúc mười một giờ.
A
Hi, the air conditioner in my room isn't working.
Chào, máy lạnh phòng tôi không hoạt động.
B
I'm sorry about that. I'll send someone up right away.
Tôi xin lỗi. Tôi sẽ cử người lên ngay.
A
Excuse me, how do I get to the central station?
Xin lỗi, đến ga trung tâm đi thế nào?
B
Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the bank.
Đi thẳng hai dãy nhà rồi rẽ trái ở ngân hàng.
A
Is it far on foot?
Đi bộ có xa không?
B
About ten minutes. Or you can take the number five bus.
Khoảng mười phút. Hoặc bạn đi xe buýt số năm.
A
Could you take me to this address, please?
Bạn chở tôi đến địa chỉ này được không?
B
Sure. There is a traffic jam, so it may take half an hour.
Được. Đang kẹt xe nên có thể mất nửa tiếng.
A
Two tickets for the museum, please. Is there a student discount?
Cho hai vé vào bảo tàng. Có giảm giá cho sinh viên không?
B
Yes, students pay half the entrance fee. May I see your ID?
Có, sinh viên trả nửa phí vào cửa. Cho tôi xem thẻ nhé?
A
Here you go. Can I take photos inside?
Của bạn đây. Trong này chụp ảnh được không?
B
Yes, but no flash. You can rent an audio guide over there.
Được, nhưng không dùng đèn flash. Bạn thuê tai nghe thuyết minh ở đằng kia.
A
Are there any guided tours of the old town today?
Hôm nay có tour có hướng dẫn khu phố cổ không?
B
Yes, one at two o'clock. It's about two hours long.
Có, một tour lúc hai giờ. Kéo dài khoảng hai tiếng.
A
Hello, my luggage hasn't arrived. I flew in from Hanoi.
Xin chào, hành lý của tôi chưa tới. Tôi bay từ Hà Nội.
B
I'm sorry. Please fill in this form, and we'll try to find it.
Xin lỗi bạn. Vui lòng điền mẫu này, chúng tôi sẽ cố tìm.
A
How long will it take? I'm only here for three days.
Mất bao lâu? Tôi chỉ ở đây ba ngày.
B
Usually one or two days. We'll deliver it to your hotel.
Thường một đến hai ngày. Chúng tôi sẽ giao tới khách sạn.
A
My flight was cancelled. Can I get a refund or rebook?
Chuyến bay của tôi bị hủy. Tôi được hoàn tiền hay đổi chuyến?
B
You can do either. There is a seat on tomorrow's flight.
Bạn chọn cái nào cũng được. Chuyến ngày mai còn ghế.
A
Good morning. May I see your passport and visa?
Chào buổi sáng. Cho tôi xem hộ chiếu và thị thực nhé?
B
Here you are. I'm here on holiday for two weeks.
Của tôi đây. Tôi sang đây nghỉ hai tuần.
A
Do you have anything to declare?
Bạn có gì cần khai báo không?
B
No, nothing to declare.
Không, tôi không có gì phải khai báo.
A
Hi, where can I exchange some dollars?
Chào, tôi đổi đô la ở đâu được?
B
There's a currency exchange desk by the exit. The exchange rate is fair.
Có quầy đổi tiền cạnh lối ra. Tỷ giá khá ổn.
